3d-render: A precise computer-generated look: smooth volumetric forms read through simulated light, soft ambient occlusion, polished physically based specular highlights and no drawn outlines.
70s-anime: A vintage hand-painted cel-animation look: bold angular draftsmanship, expressive hand-drawn ink lines, simplified painted-cel colour and the slightly faded, warm grain of an old film print.
8-bit-style: An 8-bit pixel-art look: hard square pixels for all line and shading, an extremely limited palette, stepped visible colour bands instead of gradients and a rigid grid-locked retro console finish.
akira-toriyama-style: A bright retro manga-cel look: clean, highly readable linework, rounded chunky forms, polished cel rendering with simple two-tone shading and bright saturated colour with strong graphic clarity.
alphonse-mucha-masterwork: An art nouveau lithographic poster look: flowing organic outlines, whiplash curves, halo-like circular motifs, intricate ornamental borders and gold-leaf accents on soft muted colour.
analog-photography: A tactile analog-photography look: natural film grain, mild halation around highlights, slightly muted tonal range with soft imperfect transitions and honest natural available light with a nostalgic film materiality.
arcane-animation-still: A painterly 3D animation look: visible hand-painted brush texture projected onto stylized angular forms, dramatic chiaroscuro with bold graphic shadows, clean linework and moody atmospheric colour.
atmospheric-matte-painting: A film matte-painting look: expansive painted depth, realistic atmospheric perspective with haze receding into distance, refined lighting gradients and seamless photoreal painterly integration.
bande-dessinee-herge-goscinny-tradition: A classic ligne claire look: uniform unmodulated contour lines, evenly flat colour fills with minimal shading, precise detailed settings drawn with the same clarity and a flat-colour album-print finish.
beatrix-potter-style: A small-format pen-and-watercolour look: delicate softly blended washes, fine detailed lines used for texture rather than outline, soft diffused light and a quiet naturalist precision.
berserk-manga-style: A dark-fantasy seinen pen-and-ink look: obsessive crosshatched detail, dense weathered textures, dramatic black-and-white value structure and countless layers of disciplined inked line.
black-and-white-documentary: A black-and-white documentary photography look: rich grayscale with strong tonal separation, natural available light, subtle film grain and the deep blacks of a silver-gelatin print.
blue-hour-cinema: A blue-hour digital-cinema look: cool deep-blue ambient twilight balanced against warm practical lights, soft atmospheric haze, refined tonal gradients and a polished large-format finish.
bruce-timm-noir: A noir animation look: clean geometric simplification, confident silhouettes, dramatic shadow shapes painted on black backgrounds and a limited, muted art-deco palette.
castlevania-concept-art: A gothic dark-fantasy concept-art look: painterly digital linework, moody desaturated palette with crimson and moonlit-blue accents, ornate baroque detail and atmospheric fog around sharply lit focal points.
cel-shading: A cel-shaded 3D look: hard-edged stepped light and shadow tones with no smooth gradient, bold outlines on every shape and a crisp toon-shader finish within a fully dimensional render.
charcoal-rendering: A charcoal drawing look: rich tonal gradation, deep velvety blacks, smudged and erased highlights, expressive layered mark-making and the tactile tooth of drawing paper.
chinese-ink-drawing: A traditional ink-wash painting look: fluid calligraphic brushstrokes, varying ink density from brush pressure and water dilution, generous empty negative space and monochrome tones on absorbent paper.
cinematic-anime: A theatrical anime look: refined linework, hyper-detailed photoreal painted backgrounds and skies, sophisticated lighting with lens flares and glittering light particles and polished atmospheric depth.
cinematic-final-fantasy-3d-render: A pre-rendered JRPG cutscene look: near-photoreal 3D modelling, dramatic film-grade lighting, luminous subsurface-scattered surfaces and glossy reflective detail with a blockbuster CGI polish.
cinematic-photography: A feature-film photographic look: wide aspect ratio, unified colour grading across highlights and shadows, soft motivated light sources and a polished anamorphic finish with gentle lens softness.
cinematic-tron: A sleek digital-frontier look: glowing neon circuitry lines against deep matte black, hard vector-precise geometric paneling, volumetric haze and lens bloom radiating from every glowing seam.
classic-disney-feature-animation: A golden-age feature-animation look: rounded appealing hand-drawn shapes, smooth cel paint with gentle gradation, lush watercolour and gouache multiplane backgrounds and soft, warm inviting light.
claymation: A plasticine stop-motion look: soft rounded clay forms with visible fingerprints and dents, slightly irregular handmade surfaces, warm even lighting and miniature handcrafted sets.
collector-storybook-illustration: A golden-age fairy-tale illustration look: sinuous ink lines under muted tea-stained watercolour washes, intricate decorative detail and jewel-toned egg-tempera richness with atmospheric depth.
contemporary-oil-painting: A contemporary realist oil-painting look: visible confident brushwork, smooth wet-on-wet and glazed tonal transitions, brush marks kept even in refined passages and deliberate value control.
contemporary-ukiyo-e: A contemporary ukiyo-e woodblock look: flat clearly bounded colour shapes, fluid calligraphic outlines, tone from overlapping flat planes and a crisp, clean digital print finish.
cyberpunk: A frenetic neon-anime look: jagged aggressive linework, clean cel colour over gritty textural noise and saturated neon yellow, magenta and cyan glow blooming hard around every luminous edge.
cyberpunk-photography: A neon-noir night photography look: saturated coloured gel light in sharp bands, wet reflective surfaces, humid haze and deep engulfing shadow broken by isolated glowing accents.
dark-fantasy-illustration: A tenebrist dark-fantasy painting look: deep shadow swallowing the edges, a single dramatic light source carving form from darkness, weathered painterly textures and a muted, oppressive palette.
film-noir-2: A classic film-noir look: stark high-contrast monochrome, hard-edged pools of light carved from darkness, atmospheric haze diffusing the light sources, wet reflective surfaces and sharp black silhouettes.
frank-miller-style: A stark noir graphic-novel look: oversized spotted blacks carving aggressive light-and-dark extremes, sharp angular linework, minimal inner detail and white-on-black negative-space rendering.
ghibli-style: A gentle hand-painted animation look: soft watercolour-like shading, naturalistic backgrounds in poster-colour gouache, rounded softened forms and a warm, hushed, slightly faded palette.
golden-hour-photography: A golden-hour photography look: low raking warm sunlight, long soft shadows, gentle backlit glow with atmospheric scattering and warm, low-contrast luminosity.
graphic-novel: A mature graphic-novel look: deliberate confident linework, tonal shading through cross-hatching, wash or restrained colour and a grounded, atmospheric tonal weight.
hyper-synthwave: A synthwave retro-futurist look: intense neon glow in saturated magenta, cyan and violet bands, glowing perspective grids, strong backlit silhouettes and dense luminous haze.
kay-nielsen-style: A golden-age fairy-tale illustration look: sinuous calligraphic linework, flat decorative art nouveau patterning instead of shading and jewel-toned midnight blues, golds and deep greens.
kodachrome: A mid-century colour-reversal slide-film look: deep warm saturated colour with vivid reds, deep blues and warm yellows, fine crisp grain, bold contrast and honest natural light.
lego-minifigure: A plastic construction-toy look: modular parts with cylindrical studs, hard-edged interlocking geometric pieces, glossy smooth injection-moulded plastic and simple printed surface graphics.
low-poly: A low-poly 3D look: flat-shaded triangulated polygon facets, crisp hard edges between segments instead of gradients and a clean, minimalist faceted geometry with one flat colour per facet.
manga-style: A black-and-white manga look: precise confident ink linework, tonal shading built from screentone patterns and fine cross-hatching, crisp ink accents and speed lines on clean white paper.
modern-cartoon: A contemporary streaming-cartoon look: clean simplified outlines, streamlined geometric shapes, bright flat colour with only basic contact shadows and a crisp digital finish.
moebius-inspired-illustration: A clean ligne claire science-fantasy look: impossibly clean fluid linework, sparse delicate stippling and fine cross-hatching, soft pastel desert palettes and wide airy open space.
monet-style: An impressionist plein-air painting look: loose broken brushstrokes and dabs that blend optically, hazy light-drenched atmosphere and soft lilacs, water greens and pale golds.
one-piece-style: A bold adventure-manga look: energetic elastic linework, exaggerated rubbery shapes, simplified cel shading favouring graphic readability and a bright, saturated, high-contrast palette.
paper-cutout: A layered paper-cutout look: flat crisp-edged paper shapes stacked with slight offsets, no drawn lines, small drop shadows between layers and visible matte paper texture.
pixar-animation: A 3D feature-animation look: smooth rounded volumetric modelling, warm subsurface-scattered materials with an inner glow, soft three-point lighting and gentle ambient occlusion.
rubber-hose-cartoon: A 1930s rubber-hose cartoon look: smooth tubular jointless curves, thick uniform black outlines, flat minimal shading and a vintage black-and-white or faded print finish.
tenebrism: A tenebrist baroque oil-painting look: extreme contrast between engulfing darkness and a single sharp pool of light, forms emerging abruptly from shadow and refined brushwork only in the lit passages.
van-gogh-style: A post-impressionist oil-painting look: thick directional impasto strokes swirling across every surface, saturated cobalt and chrome-yellow contrasts built from layered unblended marks.
vintage-children-s-book-drawing: A vintage storybook look: soft hand-inked lines, delicate muted gouache and watercolour washes, rounded shapes and slightly faded paper with limited-run print colours.
vintage-comics: A golden-age comic-book look: confident inked linework, coarse halftone dots instead of shading, yellowed newsprint paper, slight colour misregistration and a worn offset-print texture.
watercolor-anime-illustration: A watercolour anime look: clean anime linework over delicate translucent washes, gentle bleeding and soft edges, patiently layered tones and soft directional light with a dreamy finish.
wet-on-wet-watercolor-ink-painting: A wet-on-wet watercolour look: pigment blooming and bleeding into saturated paper, soft feathered edges with no crisp boundaries and delicate translucent layered washes with ink accents.
woodcut: A woodcut relief-print look: bold gouged lines carved from negative space, stark black-and-white contrast with almost no midtones and rough hand-pressed ink edges.
